text:
emma: Heads-up — started getting p99 latency alerts for /v1/generate from a few customers (notably ACME) right after last night's platform rollout. Baseline p95 fine, p99 ~3x usual.
raj: Thanks — any correlating deploys or config flips? :thinking:
emma: We rolled the continuous-batcher config change: default `linger_ms` bumped from 8 -> 20 and `max_batch_size` reduced 512 -> 384 to lower memory pressure. Timeline matches.
mia: That jitter in linger sounds suspect for tiny payloads. Any tenant-specific routing or auth errors too?
jen-support: Customer reported timeouts and a few 504s. They provided a sample trace; tail spends ~200ms waiting in batch hold before execution.
tomas: Can you paste the example trace and request sizes? If small prompts dominate, increased linger adds head-of-line waiting for coalescing which can blow p99.
emma: Sample trace (redacted):
```
request_id: acme-req-2023
arrival: 2023-11-15T02:10:12.554Z
enqueue_wait_ms: 198
batch_formation_usec: 5
gpu_exec_ms: 12
response_send_ms: 3
```
Most requests were 5-20 tokens.
raj: Yep — tiny token requests. With reduced batch size, we also reduced how many small requests coalesce per window, so linger > bucket filling => more requests see full hold window.
mia: Quick mitigation: roll linger back to 8ms for the small-prompt tier or enable adaptive-linger that scales with recent inter-arrival.
emma: Repro steps I ran in staging:
- flood 2000 requests/s of 10-token payloads to a single shard
- capture per-request `enqueue_wait_ms` and batch sizes
- saw 95% of batches at size 2-4 and median wait ~15ms but tail hits linger value.
jen-support: Customer wants a hotfix and ETA — can we do a targeted rollback for their tenant?
tomas: We can flip a per-tenant config at the router policy to use `linger_ms=6` and `max_batch_size=512` for ACME. Ops impact minimal. Need approval to push.
raj: Approve. Also add a metric alert for batch_size_distribution and linger_wait_percentile (p99) so we catch regressions.
ops-bot: @oncall Deploy request queued: change config for tenant=acme -> linger_ms=6, max_batch_size=512. CI checks passed.
emma: Rolling now to canary (1/10 hosts) for ACME.
emma: Canary shows p99 down from 720ms -> 95ms for that tenant after change.
mia: Nice. For long-term: propose adaptive-linger experiment + heuristics: if median batch_size < 8 and request_tokens < 32 then set linger to 5ms, else keep default. Also maybe bump small-payload quota to avoid over-throttling.
raj: Agree. Please open a follow-up RFC with perf numbers from staging (before/after) and a runbook for rollback.
jen-support: I updated the support ticket with the mitigation steps and ETA. Customer acknowledged and is running validation.
emma: Filing follow-up tickets: ENG-PLAT-1523 (adaptive-linger experiment), ENG-PLAT-1524 (batching-metrics-alerts). Will keep thread updated.
raj: Thanks team. One action: capture a week of batch-size histogram and p99 by tenant so product can decide defaults per tier.
emma: Added to the RFC checklist. Closing the immediate escalation — will monitor for 24h. :thumbsup:
